When looking for the best men's wool jacket you usually end up ending on two brands...WeatherWool and Filson. Filson has a ton of legendary pieces: The Filson Mackinaw Cruiser, the Packer Coat, the Work Jacket, and even their tin cloth line is all the rage. Not too mention the briefcase. However, there is someone else on the block! Some new shawty lookin for trouble...and that's Ralph and WeatherWool. What makes WeatherWool different? Why are people obsessed with the anorak? What is the deal with the lynx pattern and a jacquard loom? Is the wool that much better? Should I do a waterproof test? Or a windproof test next? To be honest I could make this video an hour long but I had to be brief!
